subject: Whether the occupancy separation rating shown in Project Manual Section 01 00 00 complies

messages.text: We need confirmation on whether the occupancy separation rating shown in Project Manual Section 01 00 00 complies with the adopted code edition referenced in Section 26 05 00, though this may simply come down to what the design intended rather than a strict code reading. This is becoming a priority as the affected work proceeds. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is not holding up any current work. No hard deadline, just would like to keep this moving.
